metadata.title: Software and semiconductor shares are both moving higher Friday - MarketWatch

content.text:
18 hours ago
Software and semiconductor shares are both moving higher Friday
In another indication of just how strong breadth has been in the U.S. equity market on Friday, shares of software and semiconductor firms were both in rally mode.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index, a popular gauge of semiconductor performance, was up 2.3%, while the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF, which holds mostly software names, was up 0.4%.
Performance under the hood was mixed in both cases. IGV was getting a solid boost from shares of Salesforce, even as weakness in Oracle and Palo Alto Networks helped to offset it. In the semi space, Micron Technology, which is in the SOX index, was marginally lower. Meanwhile, shares of memory names like Sandisk and Western Digital — which aren't included in the SOX but compete in some ways with Micron — were also struggling.
